	input clk,    
	input rst,  
	input [4:0] src1,
	input [4:0] src2,
	input [4:0] dest,

	input Write_EN,

	input clk,    
	input rst,  
	input [4:0] src1,
	input [4:0] src2,

	input Write_EN,
	output reg[31:0]reg1,
	output reg[31:0]reg2
);reg [31:0]register[31:0];
integer i;

always @(*) begin : proc_READ
	if(rst) begin
		reg1 = 0;
		reg2 = 0;
	end else begin
		reg1 = register[src1];
		reg2 = register[src2];
	end
end

		end
	end

		if (Write_EN) 
		begin
			register[dest] <= Write_Val;
		end
	end
end

endmodule
